Dome: Add dev server. Add a dev mode server for Dome at "./setup/cros_docker.sh dev". The server read code directly from the host folder, and would restart backend server when there's any change. This makes testing simple changes in Dome much easier. For frontend TypeScript code, the React module would hot reload without losing state by using react-hot-loader, so developer would immediately see changes in frontend when saving code. Instalog: Change the process flow of the plugins using GCS. The process flow we are using now duplicate all events, and it slow down the whole Instalog. To improve the performance, we change the process flow of output_bigquery and output_archive plugins. The process flow before this CL: 1. input -> buffer -> output_gcs -> buffer -> output_bigquery 2. input -> buffer -> output_archive -> buffer -> output_gcs The process flow after this CL: 1. input -> buffer -> output_bigquery 2. input -> buffer -> output_archive BUG=b:112063669, b:112015018 TEST=manually test on the local device Change-Id: Icb47697ba9cc6864ef92dc65098d2e2fce71c202 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1158312 Commit-Ready: Chun-Tsen Kuo <chuntsen@chromium.org> Tested-by: Chun-Tsen Kuo <chuntsen@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ting Shen <phoenixshen@chromium.org>
